sources.title: PeopleGroups.org — Afar of Ethiopia (PGID PG011536)
sources.locator: Current profile fast facts and resource sections: Afar in Ethiopia, Afar (aar), aggregate Sunni Islam label, GSEC/SPI presentation, JESUS/Magdalena and linked Bible-resource surfaces. Live PEID/PGID identity must be re-fetched before publication.

sources.title: Glottolog 5.3 — Afar
sources.publisher: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology / Glottolog
sources.locator: Afar spoken L1 language entry: glottocode afar1241, ISO 639-3 aar; current language-status metadata and classification references.

sources.title: Facilitating livelihoods diversification through flood-based land restoration in pastoral systems of Afar, Ethiopia
sources.publisher: Cambridge University Press / Renewable Agriculture and Food Systems
sources.locator: Introduction and study framing on pastoral and agro-pastoral livelihood systems in Ethiopia's Afar Region, mobility, resource access and livelihood diversification pressures.

whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Afar in Ethiopia and ties the record to the Afar language (aar). Glottolog independently identifies Afar as a spoken L1 language, while region-focused academic research documents pastoral and agro-pastoral livelihood systems in Ethiopia's Afar Region without implying one occupation or lifestyle for every Afar person.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate Sunni Islam label for this people-group-in-country record. It is retained as source context and not generalized into a claim about the belief or practice of every Afar person.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: This candidate explains the current unreached classification only from PeopleGroups.org mission-status fields. Pastoralism, geography, language and religion are not treated as causes of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current source mission status
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports the Afar of Ethiopia below the 2% evangelical threshold and assigns GSEC 3, indicating dispersed church-planting activity while retaining an unreached classification.

whyUnreached.heading: Reported resources exist, but availability is not the same as access
whyUnreached.summary: The provider page links Afar-language film and Bible resources; this candidate preserves those source labels without inferring distribution, comprehension or use across Afar communities.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile PG011536 identifies the people-group record as Afar in Ethiopia and lists Afar (aar) as its primary language.
claims.interpretationNote: The public profile establishes PGID/name/country/language alignment; live PEID identity must still be re-fetched by the guarded publication review before this draft can be published.

claims.text: Glottolog identifies Afar with glottocode afar1241 and ISO 639-3 code aar.

Academic research focused on Ethiopia's Afar Region describes pastoralism and agro-pastoralism as important regional livelihood systems and documents pressures toward livelihood diversification; this supports regional human context but not an assumption that every Afar household has the same livelihood.
claims.interpretationNote: The academic study concerns pastoral systems in Afar Region rather than a census of every person represented by PG011536.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org Afar of Ethiopia profile reports Sunni Islam as its aggregate primary-religion label.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider-level aggregate classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Afar person's belief or practice.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently reports less than 2% evangelical presence and GSEC 3, 'Less than 2% Evangelical, Dispersed CP Activity,' for PG011536 and presents the record as Engaged yet Unreached.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record and are not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile lists JESUS and Magdalena film resources for Afar (aar) and links Afar Bible-resource providers.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider resource links do not establish local distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness.
